title: Filipino-Style Buckwheat Noodle Dish
description: A flavorful and nutritious Filipino-inspired buckwheat noodle dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the nutty flavor of buckwheat noodles with the vibrant spices of the Philippines.
instructions: Cook the buckwheat noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the vibrant vegetable stir-fry mix to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced pineapple to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and chili flakes.
Pour the sauce over the vegetable mixture in the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked buckwheat noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional vibrant vegetables if desired.
